title: DEPHYRIER Tiga Perintah (Cloud Clean Local Catch Up)
style: sync pulse 108 bpm trilingual EN ID FR DEPHYRIER signature git-fetch-tone terminal-pulse cold-synth typewriter-percussion spoken-indonesian
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Ten twenty eight PM the cloud is one hundred clean
Repository current everything pushed and seen
Mac side still behind the local needs the pull
Three commands in terminal make the ledger full

[Pre-Chorus — Indonesian]
Cloud sudah bersih lokal harus mengejar
(Cloud is already clean local must catch up)
Git fetch git pull tiga perintah benar
(Git fetch git pull three commands correct)

[Chorus — Trilingual]
DEPHYRIER cloud clean local catch up now
Le cloud est propre le local doit suivre
(The cloud is clean the local must follow)
Cloud bersih lokal harus mengejar
(Cloud clean local must catch up)

[Verse 2]
cd tilde Desktop coreintent first
git fetch origin then the merge gets nursed
Not a hand wave not a roughly synced
Three commands typed and the gap is rinsed

[Bridge — French]
Le distant a parlé le local doit répondre
(The remote spoke the local must respond)
Fetch puis merge la dérive va fondre
(Fetch then merge the drift will melt)

[Outro — Trilingual]
DEPHYRIER fetch merge pull semua
Le local rattrape o cloud já está
DEPHYRIER three commands and the ledger is true
